speaker: judith_sadler
text: I can see the three of them. They are still a row. Go while a row is what they are.

speaker: hamnet_sadler
text: The oven is my farewell. It is enough of one. I am not coming down the lane to add a better.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The three are ahead, and the cloth is with the one who can carry it. We look like people who meant them to be.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We meant them. Come. The heat can stay in the house that made it.
